# Ezeebit

> Ezeebit is crypto and stablecoin payment infrastructure for merchants and platforms. Businesses use it to accept crypto and stablecoin payments in-store, online, and on their own platforms, and to pay customers out in stablecoin. It is not a retail cryptocurrency exchange, and it is not an Australian exchange.

Ezeebit (Ezee Solutions Group (Pty) Ltd) builds the checkout, conversion, and settlement layer. A customer pays from a crypto wallet or an exchange account. The business is settled the same day, on every plan, in a stablecoin (USDT or USDC) or in ZAR, KES, NGN or USD, at the rate locked when the customer paid. The company is based in Cape Town, South Africa. Ezeebit is live in South Africa, Kenya and Nigeria, with more markets to follow.

Ezeebit is regulated by the FSCA as a Crypto Asset Service Provider, FSP No. 53664. The FSCA is South Africa's Financial Sector Conduct Authority.

Ezeebit does not offer retail crypto trading and this site does not give investment advice.

## Products

- **Platforms**: crypto pay-ins and stablecoin payouts for gaming, trading, wallet, and payment platforms, through one API. <https://ezeebit.com/platforms>
- **In-store**: the Ezeebit ePOS, an Android point of sale for physical stores, and free Ezeebit Pay QR codes. <https://ezeebit.com/in-store>
- **Online**: plugins for Shopify, WooCommerce, and Magento, and a hosted checkout through the API. <https://ezeebit.com/online>
- **Payouts**: pay customers from a fiat balance in USDT, with more stablecoins coming soon. The recipient opens a link, chooses the network, and adds their own wallet. <https://ezeebit.com/payouts>
- **Wallets**: hold fiat and USDT, convert between them at a quoted rate, fund payouts, and withdraw to a bank account or a wallet. <https://ezeebit.com/wallets>
- **Customer accounts**: a USDT wallet for each of a platform's customers, with deposit addresses on Ethereum, BNB Smart Chain, Tron, and Solana. <https://docs.ezeebit.com/customer-accounts/overview>
- **OTC desk**: large crypto-to-fiat trades quoted by a named dealer, settled the same day in ZAR, KES, NGN or USD. <https://ezeebit.com/otc>
- **Developer API**: signed REST endpoints for payments, payouts, wallets, and customer accounts, with signed webhooks. <https://ezeebit.com/developers>

## Pricing

- Crypto In: 1% or less per payment, excluding VAT.
- Crypto Out: $0.75 or less per payout, excluding VAT.
- No setup fees and no monthly platform fees.
- The Ezeebit ePOS is optional, at R150 a month per device. An Ezeebit Pay QR code is free.
- Enterprise pricing is based on volume.
- Full details: <https://ezeebit.com/pricing>

## Who it is for

- Platforms that take deposits and pay users out: gaming and betting operators, trading and investment platforms, payment gateways, wallets, and neobanks.
- Merchants: online stores, shops, hospitality, and multi-store retailers.
- Marketplaces that pay sellers, drivers, and creators.
- Businesses making large crypto-to-fiat trades.

## How a payment works

1. The customer pays in-store (ePOS or Ezeebit Pay QR code), online (plugin or hosted checkout), or on a platform (a deposit created through the API).
2. Ezeebit locks the rate at checkout and hedges the payment, so the business does not hold a volatile asset.
3. The business is settled the same day in USDT or USDC, or in ZAR, KES, NGN or USD.

Supported assets are BTC, ETH, USDT, USDC, BNB, DAI, PAXG, ZARP, and ZARU, on Bitcoin, Ethereum, Tron, BNB Smart Chain, and Solana. Customers can pay from any wallet on-chain, through WalletConnect Pay, or directly from Luno, VALR, or Binance where those connections are switched on.

## Common questions

**What is Ezeebit?** Crypto and stablecoin payment infrastructure for businesses. It is not a consumer crypto exchange.

**Is Ezeebit regulated?** Yes. Ezeebit is regulated by the FSCA as a Crypto Asset Service Provider, FSP No. 53664. In Kenya, Ezee Solutions Group (Kenya) Limited operates under the transitional provisions of the Virtual Asset Service Providers Act, 2025. In Canada, Ezeebit Canada Ltd. is on FINTRAC's money services business registry, MSB No. N300001912.

**Which countries does Ezeebit operate in?** It is live in South Africa, Kenya, and Nigeria, with more markets to follow.

**What does Ezeebit cost?** Crypto In is 1% or less per payment and Crypto Out is $0.75 or less per payout, both excluding VAT, with no setup fees or monthly platform fees.

**How fast is settlement?** The same day, in local currency (ZAR, KES, NGN), in USD, or in stablecoin.

**Are there chargebacks?** No. A confirmed crypto payment is final.

**Does the business have to hold crypto?** No. Each payment is hedged when it is made, and the business can settle entirely in fiat.

**Do customers need an Ezeebit account or app?** No. They pay from the wallet or exchange app they already use.

**Can a business pay its customers out?** Yes, in USDT, from its fiat balance. The recipient claims a payout link with their own wallet, and funds usually arrive within minutes.

## Markets

- Ezeebit is live in South Africa, Kenya and Nigeria, with more markets to follow.
- Settlement is the same day on every plan: in local currency (ZAR, KES or NGN), in USD, or in stablecoin.
